Use case: logo-brand. Design ONE original TD logo exploration for ToolDawn, an AI productivity tools platform. Previous rounds were rejected because all concepts resembled the same rounded geometric initials recolored. This round MUST fully commit to its unique style: letter construction, typography, composition, materials and mood must match the specified direction, NOT default rounded SaaS branding.
Canvas square 1024x1024. Make the TD monogram the dominant hero, taking about half the canvas width with breathing room around it. Include exact brand text "ToolDawn" once in a supporting position and typographic style suited to this concept. Text besides the monogram and ToolDawn is forbidden: no numbers, captions, watermark, slogans, fake design notes or random letters. One coherent logo design per image, not a sheet of variants, not a two-panel light/dark presentation. Both T and D must be recognizable. Use uppercase or lowercase as specified. No generic sun, leaf, gear, wrench or bird symbols. Do not imitate existing brands. This is an exploratory visual identity board, not a website screenshot or merchandise mockup.
Specific art direction: Radical minimal geometric identity. A compact TD monogram created from one black solid T and one semicircular D bowl with a very clever shared negative space, extremely few shapes, architectural optical balance. Black ink on pure white with one tiny vermilion accent. Flat vector artwork, absolutely no dimensional effects. Quiet museum-design identity, spacious composition. Small ToolDawn wordmark in restrained modern sans.
